transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Arjun. How can I help you today?
Customer: I am so frustrated with my latest bill. It's way too high and I think I've been charged incorrectly for roaming charges that I didn't even use!
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you're feeling frustrated. I can certainly look into those charges for you.
Agent: Before we dive into the account, could you please provide your account number and date of birth for verification?
Customer: My account number is 67141834 and my date of birth is 01/10/1996.
Agent: Thank you, Emily Gupta. I see the roaming charges here. It looks like it was a mistake on our end.
Customer: It's just ridiculous. I was at home the whole time. Why is this happening?
Agent: I apologize for the error. I'll make sure you're never charged for roaming again.
Agent: I will now raise a refund request for the wrong charge to be credited back to your account.
Customer: Thank you. I also want to change my plan to something cheaper because I'm not using all the data I have.
Agent: I can help you with that. I will process the plan change and send a confirmation SMS to your phone number 93676 39649.
Customer: That's great. I'm much happier now that this is sorted out. Thank you so much for your help, Arjun.
Agent: You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I've raised the refund and updated your plan. Have a great day. Goodbye!
